ipc.title: IPC-D-356 netlist exported by kicad-cli 10.0.6 from the KiCad import of icicle_kit_rev_1p0_20-0532_pcb_0624_01.brd
ipc.licence_note: Net names per pad; derived data, see docs/PLAN.md section 3.5. Net names are truncated to their last 14 characters and refdes to 6 by the IPC-D-356 format

sources_used.pdc: reference-design constraint files associated with PLACEROUTE in the standard design: ICICLE.pdc, ICICLE_CAN0.pdc, ICICLE_MAC.pdc, ICICLE_MIKROBUS.pdc, ICICLE_MMUART0.pdc, ICICLE_MMUART1.pdc, ICICLE_MMUART2.pdc, ICICLE_MMUART3.pdc, ICICLE_PCIE.pdc, ICICLE_RPi.pdc, ICICLE_SDIO.pdc, ICICLE_USB.pdc
sources_used.job: BSR_IO_States in header.xml of the v2026.04 ES job (port, ball, boundary-scan cell index); covers MSS I/O (DDR, SD/eMMC, SPI1, I2C1, CAN, MDIO) as well as fabric I/O
sources_used.netlist: board net at U1.<ball> from build/kicad/icicle.ipc (full net name recovered from the .kicad_pcb)

verification_values.two-source: the PDC constraint and the job's BSR list give the same ball
verification_values.single-source: one of them only (MSS I/O and transceiver pins are not in the PDC files)

net_vs_port_values.same: board net and design port have the same name
net_vs_port_values.different: names differ, e.g. port LED0 drives net LED1 and port SW1 reads net SWITCH1

mss_io_note: U1 balls outside the fabric design whose net belongs to an MSS peripheral used by the tables; netlist only. WP-01's public/data/board/pins.json carries every U1 ball.

pins.note: VSS_87 (ground) in the schematic, sheet 15; in the board netlist it is the only pad on NET_1082, so the layout does not connect it

pins_note: pins = every U1 pad in the netlist with its board net; port/macro/ioStandard where the reference design uses the ball. bank is the set_iobank of the PDC file that places the port (a hint, not a package-pin lookup).
